The '''Vain Goddess''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Deity/Legends|deity]] of the [[Stellan (species)|Stellan]] mythology. She was believed to incite [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to unending war through a song of [[Blood/Legends|bloodshed]], and the Stellan used to exile those who were deemed a danger to others in order to repel her influence.<ref name="TNMS" />
